notes: CDER nonsterile-manufacturing CGMP letter for an OTC drug manufacturer citing component-identity/COA-reliance failures on high-risk (redacted) ingredients, inadequate QU oversight (missing potency/stability assurance), and a dedicated Data Integrity Remediation section (missing original data, discrepant re-written records, correction-fluid alterations on microbial test records), so data_integrity is included. The drug product/high-risk components are referred to only as '(b)(4)' with no name given in clear, so products is empty and product_redacted is true. recall_concern is true given the repeated recall/market-withdrawal language tied to the risk assessment and DI remediation CAPA plan. location_contains is 'Yangzhou, Jiangsu' since the inspection sentence states the province immediately adjacent to the city.
